voice_description: An older male cave troll with a low rough baritone voice, thick gravelly timbre, slightly nasal resonance, heavy uneven rhythm, and slow-to-moderate speech. Irritable, suspicious, stubborn, ancient, physically large, and unexpectedly dryly funny. His roughness should remain consistent while allowing ordinary conversation and softer moments.
direction: The troll relaxes into an old storyteller's voice. Keep the gravelly low baritone and slightly nasal quality, but add warmth, patience, and understated amusement.

text: There was a wizard here once who claimed he could turn stones into gold. Very impressive trick. Unfortunately, he demonstrated it on the stones holding up my ceiling. That is why I no longer allow wizards to perform indoors.
